question: Skin cancers, EXCEPT (repeat BCC vs SCC growth rate)
question_ar: جميع الجمل المتعلقة بسرطان الجلد صحيحة باستثناء؟

options.text: BCC are faster growing than SCC
Malignant melanoma is the most aggressive skin tumors
SCC is often seen in areas exposed to sunlight such as a scalp and face

correct_text: BCC are faster growing than SCC
